Portronics Mopcop 4 Vacuum Cleaner – High Power Portable Car Cleaning Solution

The Portronics Mopcop 4 Vacuum Cleaner is designed for powerful, convenient, and quick cleaning wherever you need it. Built for modern users, this portable vacuum cleaner delivers an impressive suction power of 18,000 Pa, making it ideal for removing dust, dirt, crumbs, and pet hair from car interiors, sofas, carpets, and tight corners. With a sleek black finish and ergonomic design, the MopCop 4 combines performance with portability.

Powered by a rechargeable battery and supported by DC output from a cigarette lighter socket, this car vacuum cleaner ensures uninterrupted cleaning during travel. Whether you are maintaining your vehicle daily or preparing for a long trip, the Portronics Mopcop 4 Vacuum Cleaner helps keep your surroundings spotless with minimal effort.

Powerful 18,000 Pa Suction for Deep Cleaning

Equipped with a high-performance motor, the MopCop 4 provides strong and stable suction to lift stubborn debris. From fine dust particles hidden in seat gaps to larger waste like food crumbs, this handheld vacuum cleaner captures everything efficiently. The advanced airflow system ensures consistent performance while keeping noise under control.

Rechargeable & Car Powered Convenience

The dual power flexibility makes the perfect for home and automotive use. Use the rechargeable battery for cordless mobility or plug it into your car’s cigarette lighter socket for extended cleaning sessions. This feature makes it one of the most reliable portable car options available today.

Compact, Lightweight & Easy to Handle

Designed to reach narrow spaces, under seats, and between cushions, the MopCop 4 offers effortless maneuverability. The lightweight body reduces fatigue and allows quick cleanups anytime. Its modern black color complements your car accessories while maintaining a premium look.

Multi-Purpose Usage

Beyond vehicles, this works efficiently on office desks, keyboards, furniture, and home corners. If you are searching for a high suction handheld that adapts to multiple environments, the is a smart investment.

Key Features

  • Model Name: MopCop 4
  • Product Type: Vacuum Cleaner
  • Colour: Black
  • Powerful suction capacity of 18,000 Pa
  • Power Source: Rechargeable Battery & DC output from cigarette lighter socket
  • Ideal for car interior, sofa, carpet, and quick cleanups
  • Compact, portable, and easy to store
  • Efficient dust pickup for dry waste and fine particles

Why Choose?

When it comes to maintaining hygiene inside your vehicle, power and portability matter most. The MopCop 4 stands out with strong suction, durable construction, and flexible charging support. It is built for users who want fast results without bulky equipment. Perfect for everyday use, road trips, family cars, and professional detailing touch-ups. Upgrade your cleaning routine with the and experience superior suction, effortless reach, and reliable performance every time.
